name: The Blade Building (1927), 541 N Superior St at Orange St
refs: No open-licence photo; built from Blade/HMDB descriptions ('grand grey castle', 1926-27) + LiDAR.
notes: Renaissance Revival newspaper headquarters in grey stone: rusticated ground floor with big round-arched windows, regular punched windows in the upper storeys, belt course and heavy cornice with parapet. Height and footprint from LiDAR; window rhythm approximated.
